column1: # The framework fixes of services.jar per Lumen base (services.py, README.md "services.jar"). A base is one LineageOS 21
# system build that images take their framework from; every image of the base gets the same six files.
#   base   NAME  ISA  GC  DEX2OAT  OUT   the base build's dexpreopt target: instruction set, cmc (uffd GC) or cc, the
#                                        dex2oat of its host tools (soong runs dex2oatd), its OUT_DIR (the app image
#                                        records the host path of the class loader jar below it)
#   input  NAME  KEY  SHA256             a pinned input: the class loader jar, the profile listings of
#                                        frameworks/base/services, the LineageOS 21 sources of the replaced classes
#   file   NAME  PATH  BASE_SHA256  PATCHED_SHA256   a file of the base image and the one the fix puts in its place
# z9x:  the Z9X 1.0.9 anp image (lineage_gsi_tv_arm64, uffd GC): Z9X, the X50 family, TITAN, RS 20
# p6:   the Play 6 base play6-out (lineage_gsi_tv_arm with lineage/patches/play6, concurrent copying GC): HB, Play 6
# rs30: the RS30 base ~/rs30-base of builder-llm (lineage_gsi_tv_arm, play6 patches, uffd GC): RS30 lines, MIRA, AURA
